title: The three-way promise 'pay it yourself / let the hold pay it / let it lapse' at Reedholm's tithe and Thornwold's oath-toll was crystal clear and well telegraphed with gold costs shown up front -- worth calling out as the game's clearest moment, in contrast to the murkier Vale Barrow Doors thread.
